## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link relevant source
filings or issues; identify the stack base when applicable.

## Validation

Record checks and results. For parser/data changes, link before/after measurements
and source regressions. For UI changes, include a screenshot and verified route/state.

## Limits and data impact

Note unresolved cases, cache/version or migration changes, regenerated snapshots
and effects on review gates. Distinguish implemented behavior from future work.
